cards.englishCore: An original stylized 3D world inhabited by anthropomorphic animals, rendered as polished sculptural feature-animation CGI. Expressive architectural silhouettes, gently softened edges, selectively exaggerated usable proportions, broad coordinated color planes and softly painted tactile materials establish a mature animated identity. Curate a moderate level of detail: give the main action area clear shapes and access, retain convincing functional furnishings, and group signs of everyday use along the edges and in the middle distance. Distinguish action-related seats, doors and objects through stable colors, shapes and positions. Directional light, readable colored shadows and controlled reflections preserve depth and material character.

cards.englishCore: An original medieval fantasy steampunk world inhabited by anthropomorphic animals, rendered as polished sculptural feature-animation CGI. Expressive stone-and-timber architecture, deep arched openings, selectively exaggerated usable proportions and chunky softened bevels define the world. Coherent copper-and-brass heating pipes, valves and mechanical lamps integrate with functional modern devices. Broad coordinated saturated color planes, softly painted tactile materials, luminous color bounce and readable contact shadows preserve the animated identity. Curated furnishings, layered architectural detail and grouped signs of everyday use enrich the setting while clear action landmarks and circulation remain prominent. Lighting follows visible sources, the actual time of day and the scene's emotional purpose.

cards.title: 当代都市＋轻复古生活＋情感悬疑动物CG
cards.status: v02温馨卡通方向用户已确认；局部萝卜元素认可；无逐图观察
cards.englishCore: An original contemporary anthropomorphic-animal city, rendered as distinctly stylized cartoon feature-animation CGI with the emotional depth of an adult urban drama. Subtly flared portals, thick offset frames, bowed furniture bases and sculpted cushion shapes create an expressive architectural rhythm. Simplified tactile materials, broad coordinated color planes and softly painted surfaces make the animated design clearly visible. Contemporary interiors carry selective retro warmth through timber, fabric and ceramic. Tail clearance, paw-friendly handles or smaller residents' reachable storage integrate species needs into useful furnishings where appropriate. Curated everyday detail enriches secondary areas, while stable seat colors, clear spatial landmarks and open paths support the action. Source-based directional light, broad color bounce and readable contact shadows preserve depth and emotional nuance.
